an4.193:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an4.193:1.2: athakho bhaddiyo licchavi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho bhaddiyo licchavi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an4.193:2.2: māyāvī samaṇo gotamo āvaṭṭanimāyaṃ jānāti yāya aññatitthiyānaṃ sāvake āvaṭṭetīti
an4.193:2.4: māyāvī samaṇo gotamo āvaṭṭanimāyaṃ jānāti yāya aññatitthiyānaṃ sāvake āvaṭṭetīti kacci te bhante bhagavato vuttavādino na ca bhagavantaṃ abhūtena abbhācikkhanti dhammassa cānudhammaṃ byākaronti na ca koci sahadhammiko vādānupāto gārayhaṃ ṭhānaṃ āgacchati anabbhakkhātukāmā hi mayaṃ bhante bhagavantanti.
an4.193:3.1: etha tumhe bhaddiya mā anussavena mā paramparāya mā itikirāya mā piṭakasampadānena mā takkahetu mā nayahetu mā ākāraparivitakkena mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā mā bhabbarūpatāya mā samaṇo no garūti
an4.193:3.3: ime dhammā akusalā ime dhammā sāvajjā ime dhammā viññugarahitā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantīti atha tumhe bhaddiya pajaheyyātha
an4.193:4.2: lobho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vāti.
an4.193:4.4: luddho panāyaṃ bhaddiya purisapuggalo lobhena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto pāṇaṃpi hanati adinnaṃpi ādiyati paradāraṃpi gacchati musāpi bhaṇati paraṃpi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃsa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
an4.193:5.2: doso … moho … sārambho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vāti.
an4.193:5.4: sārambho panāyaṃ bhaddiya purisapuggalo sārambhena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto pāṇaṃpi hanati adinnaṃpi ādiyati paradāraṃpi gacchati musāpi bhaṇati paraṃpi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃsa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
an4.193:6.1: taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhaddiya ime dhammā kusalā vā akusalā vāti.
an4.193:6.7: samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti no vā
an4.193:6.9: samattā bhante samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti
an4.193:7.1: iti kho bhaddiya yaṃ taṃ avocumha
an4.193:7.2: etha tumhe bhaddiya mā anussavena mā paramparāya mā itikirāya mā piṭakasampadānena mā takkahetu mā nayahetu mā ākāraparivitakkena mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā mā bhabbarūpatāya mā samaṇo no garūti
an4.193:7.4: ime dhammā akusalā ime dhammā sāvajjā ime dhammā viññugarahitā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattantīti atha tumhe bhaddiya pajaheyyāthāti
an4.193:7.5: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ
an4.193:8.1: etha tumhe bhaddiya mā anussavena mā paramparāya mā itikirāya mā piṭakasampadānena mā takkahetu mā nayahetu mā ākāraparivitakkena mā diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā mā bhabbarūpatāya mā samaṇo no garūti
an4.193:8.3: ime dhammā kusalā ime dhammā anavajjā ime dhammā viññupasatthā ime dhammā samattā samādinnā hitāya sukhāya saṃvattantīti atha tumhe bhaddiya upasampajja vihareyyātha
an4.193:9.2: alobho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vāti.
an4.193:9.4: aluddho panāyaṃ bhaddiya purisapuggalo lobhena anabhibhūto apariyādiṇṇacitto neva pāṇaṃ hanati na adinnaṃ ādiyati na paradāraṃ gacchati na musā bhaṇati paraṃpi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃsa hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
an4.193:10.1: taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhaddiya adoso … amoho … asārambho purisassa ajjhattaṃ uppajjamāno uppajjati hitāya vā ahitāya vāti.
an4.193:10.3: asārambho panāyaṃ bhaddiya purisapuggalo sārambhena anabhibhūto apariyādiṇṇacitto neva pāṇaṃ hanati na adinnaṃ ādiyati na paradāraṃ gacchati na musā bhaṇati paraṃpi tathattāya samādapeti yaṃsa hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya saṃvattatīti.
an4.193:11.1: taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhaddiya ime dhammā kusalā vā akusalā vāti.

an4.193:13.1: ye kho te bhaddiya loke santo sappurisā te sāvakaṃ evaṃ samādapenti
an4.193:13.2: ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa lobhaṃ vineyya vineyya viharāhi
an4.193:13.3: lobhaṃ vineyya vineyya viharanto na lobhajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā
an4.193:13.5: dosaṃ vineyya vineyya viharanto na dosajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā
an4.193:13.7: mohaṃ vineyya vineyya viharanto na mohajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasā
an4.193:13.9: sārambhaṃ vineyya vineyya viharanto na sārambhajaṃ kammaṃ karissasi kāyena vācāya manasāti.
an4.193:14.1: evaṃ vutte bhaddiyo licchavi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an4.193:14.2: abhikkantaṃ bhante …pe… upāsakaṃ maṃ bhante bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
an4.193:15.2: ehi me tvaṃ bhaddiya sāvako hohi
an4.193:15.5: evaṃvādiṃ kho maṃ bhaddiya evamakkhāyiṃ eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti
an4.193:15.6: māyāvī samaṇo gotamo āvaṭṭanimāyaṃ jānāti yāya aññatitthiyānaṃ sāvake āvaṭṭetīti.
an4.193:15.9: piyā me bhante ñātisālohitā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ piyānaṃ me assa ñātisālohitānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
an4.193:15.10: sabbe cepi bhante khattiyā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ sabbesampissa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
an4.193:15.11: sabbe cepi bhante brāhmaṇā … vessā … suddā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ sabbesampissa suddānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
an4.193:16.2: sabbe cepi bhaddiya khattiyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhammupasampadāya sabbesampissa khattiyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
an4.193:16.3: sabbe cepi bhaddiya brāhmaṇā … vessā … suddā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhammupasampadāya sabbesampissa suddānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
an4.193:16.4: sadevako cepi bhaddiya loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇi pajā sadevamanussā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhammupasampadāya sadevakassa lokassa samārakassa sabrahmakassa sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya
an4.193:16.5: ime cepi bhaddiya mahāsālā imāya āvaṭṭaniyā āvaṭṭeyyuṃ akusaladhammappahānāya kusaladhammupasampadāya imesampissa mahāsālānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya sace ceteyyuṃ
